source_name: IEG PADEL-Mali P160641 — selected evaluation findings
methodology: Independent desk-based ICR validation; retrospective project evidence
transferability: Historical livestock project; no automatic transfer to current programmes or local needs coverage.
limitations: Three short reviewed factual paraphrases only, with exact PDF pages; not the full review or an exhaustive evaluation collection.
Reach is source-reported project monitoring for 2018–2024, not verified current local delivery, unique population across indicators or causal impact.
Baseline and end-of-project surveys were implemented; the review still identifies counterfactual attribution limits. Lessons require current-context checks.

findings.finding: IEG reports 346,465 farmers reached with agricultural assets or services against a 340,000 target. This is historical project reach, not current local coverage.
IEG notes counterfactual studies could strengthen outcome attribution. Planned baseline and end-of-project surveys were implemented; M&E quality was rated Substantial.

Lessons favor locally anchored implementation, workload monitoring in shared teams, SME credit access, and transparent matching-grant selection. These are experience-based lessons, not experimental proof.
